Widget is slow. Had my hopes too high tbh, can’t find a calculator widget that actually has the same speed as the app

Not very useful. The widget doesn’t work unless the app is also open, which makes the widget somewhat useless. The top of the numerical display is cut off by the widget frame. There is a delay of almost two seconds between each key press and the appearance of the numeral. If all you want is a slow fidget toy, try it. It’s not suitable as a serious calculator.

Love the calculator but needs to have a landscape mode. This is a great little calculator but on my iPad it only works in portrait mode. My iPad is used 99.9% in landscape since it have a Magic Keyboard
Doesn't fit on iPhone 15 Pro Max display!. On my display the operators are off the edge of the screen. It also doesn't show up as a widget in iOS 17.4 developer beta.

Uh, no. Tried this out based on a recommendation in an online article. 

I think this was a record for the shortest time from install time to delete.
Ok. It’s good but has some keyboard lag

Widget is slow. When doing calculations in the app, it’s quick but The reason I downloaded this app was so that I could have a desktop widget on my phone to do calculations quickly. But there is a lag between when you push a button and when it shows up on the screen, don’t have the patience for that

Free shouldn’t mean “unacceptable”. I appreciate the creation of a basic calculator app, one that has widget functionality for iPhone and iPad, unlike the Apple app. 

But that doesn’t mean it has to be garbage. The lag in every keystroke is brutal and completely unnecessary, it was purposely added in by the developer. There’s a special place in the afterlife for the types of people who purposely target and prey on the less fortunate.

Not working correctly. Cannot get app to come up to a size that is easy to work with. Click on several buttons that should work but nothing. Nice looking app but is a waste of time trying to get it to work.
Super happy. Excellent free app

Don't get this if you need decimal precision. 3.5 x 1.5 = 5.2 (according to this calculator)

It's actually 5.25

Same with any other decimal answer. Eg 3.5x1.50001=5.25004

Final decimal is rounded, even though there's space to display full answer

Uninstalling
